manual: Build with community-apps/cards/install.sh (CMake). Stock Devuan Excalibur Qt 6.8 is enough.
Icon loading needs qt6-svg-plugins; the window uses XCB via qt6-qpa-plugins (no qt6-wayland).
Hyprland corner rounding is skipped when HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset, so corners stay square on i3.
Theme and language follow Omarchy paths under ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/.
